lines.zh: 我顺着水流一窜，鳞片闪了一下。
lines.en: I dart with the current and my scales flash.

lines.zh: 河水推我，我偏要往上游。
lines.en: The river pushes me; I insist on going up.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底的石头走，躲开水花。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed stones and dodge the spray.

lines.zh: 我们一群转个弯，像一把银子撒开。
lines.en: Our school turns and scatters like thrown silver.

lines.zh: 冷河水让我动作更快。
lines.en: Cold river water makes me quicker.

lines.zh: 我摆尾三次，就过了这块卵石。
lines.en: Three tail beats and I clear this cobble.

lines.zh: 前面有落水，我绕到旁边。
lines.en: There is a small falls ahead; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我从水草缝里穿过去，没碰到一片。
lines.en: I slip through the weeds without touching a leaf.

lines.zh: 同伴一散，我跟着散了。
lines.en: My school scatters, and I scatter with it.

lines.zh: 我游得太急，撞上了岸边的泥。
lines.en: I swim too fast and bump the muddy bank.

lines.zh: 水面上的光照下来，我往暗处躲。
lines.en: Light falls from the surface; I slide into the dark.

lines.zh: 我沿着河湾转，那里水慢。
lines.en: I follow the river bend, where the water slows.

lines.zh: 我逆着水流停在原地，很费劲。
lines.en: I hold still against the current, and it costs me.

lines.zh: 石头后面有个凹处，我钻了进去。
lines.en: There is a hollow behind a stone; I duck inside.

lines.zh: 我顺着石缝穿过浅滩。
lines.en: I thread a stone gap through the shallows.

lines.zh: 河水凉，我的鳞片绷紧了。
lines.en: The river is cold and my scales tighten.

lines.zh: 我把嘴一张，吞下一口水。
lines.en: I open my mouth and swallow water.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面拐弯，我跟上。
lines.en: The school turns ahead and I follow.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，让水流替我动。
lines.en: I hang in the water and let the current do the work.

lines.zh: 冷得发木，可我喜欢这条河。
lines.en: I am numb with cold, yet I like this river.

lines.zh: 我数水面上的落叶，一片两片。
lines.en: I count leaves on the surface, one then two.

lines.zh: 有鱼在啃石头，我看了会儿。
lines.en: A fish is nibbling a stone; I watch a while.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，喝进一口冷水。
lines.en: I open my mouth and swallow cold water.

lines.zh: 鳞片贴着我的身，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: My scales lie flat and cool against me.

lines.zh: 我想起水里有鲨鱼，就往下沉了点。
lines.en: I remember sharks and sink a little lower.

lines.zh: 河底的石头上长着绿毛，很软。
lines.en: The river stones wear soft green hair.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，假装是片落叶。
lines.en: I hold still and pretend to be a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 水面结了薄冰，我顶了顶。
lines.en: Thin ice skins the surface; I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，泡破了，没声音。
lines.en: I blow a bubble; it pops without a sound.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里打了个转，又出来。
lines.en: I turn once in a stone crack and come back out.

lines.zh: 这条河走了很久，我也游了很久。
lines.en: This river has run long, and so have I.

lines.zh: 我等着天暗，那时水更安全。
lines.en: I wait for dusk, when the water is safer.

lines.zh: 你在岸上站着，影子落进河里。
lines.en: You stand on the bank and your shadow falls in.

lines.zh: 我只有四点血，你别伸手。
lines.en: I have four hearts; keep your hand away.

lines.zh: 你的倒影比真的大，我看了很久。
lines.en: Your reflection is bigger than you; I stare a while.

lines.zh: 我认得钩子，也认得拿钩子的手。
lines.en: I know hooks, and I know the hands that hold them.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得先下水。
lines.en: To catch me you must come into the water.

lines.zh: 我鳞片反光，你才看见我。
lines.en: You only see me because my scales catch light.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，整条河都安静了。
lines.en: You stand there and the whole river quiets.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，可你认识我。
lines.en: I do not know you, but you know me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在动，是虫子吗。
lines.en: The thing in your hand moves; is it a bug?

lines.zh: 别靠太近，水边泥很滑。
lines.en: Do not come closer; the bank mud is slick.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一片，随水漂走。
lines.en: One of my scales comes loose and drifts away.

lines.zh: 这一下让我翻了肚。
lines.en: That blow turned me belly up.

lines.zh: 我窜出去，撞了三次石头。
lines.en: I bolt and hit three stones on the way.

lines.zh: 血在水里拉出一条细线。
lines.en: Blood trails behind me in a thin line.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，气都不匀。
lines.en: I hide in a crack, breath uneven.

lines.zh: 四点血，掉一点就慌。
lines.en: Four hearts; losing one is enough to panic.

lines.zh: 我的鳍裂了，游起来打转。
lines.en: My fin is split; I swim in circles.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳，太快了。
lines.en: I hear my own heartbeat, far too fast.

lines.zh: 疼得我贴住了河底。
lines.en: The pain pins me to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我还能游，别挡我的路。
lines.en: I can still swim; do not block my way.

lines.zh: 那条虫子扭得真好，我有点想。
lines.en: That worm wriggles nicely; I want it a little.

lines.zh: 我凑过去，又想起钩子。
lines.en: I drift close, then remember hooks.

lines.zh: 我绕它转了两圈，没敢咬。
lines.en: I circle it twice and do not dare bite.

lines.zh: 这东西太香，不像白给的。
lines.en: It smells too good to be free.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了一下，立刻吐出来。
lines.en: I test it with my mouth and spit it out.

lines.zh: 你要是扔下就走，我就吃。
lines.en: If you drop it and leave, I will eat.

lines.zh: 同伴都在看，我不敢先动。
lines.en: My school is watching; I will not go first.

lines.zh: 冷河水里，活食不多。
lines.en: In cold river water, live food is scarce.

lines.zh: 我肚子空了，胆子就小了。
lines.en: My belly is empty, and my courage shrinks.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我可能就上当了。
lines.en: Try once more and I may well be fooled.

lines.zh: 你踩进河里，水一下浑了。
lines.en: You step into the river and it clouds at once.

lines.zh: 我被水流推得撞上你的腿。
lines.en: The current shoves me against your leg.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被你蹭掉两片。
lines.en: You scraped two scales off me.

lines.zh: 你一动，整群鱼都散了。
lines.en: One move from you and the whole school breaks.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边窜过去，差点卡住。
lines.en: I shoot past your feet and nearly wedge.

lines.zh: 别在水里跺脚，石头会翻。
lines.en: Do not stomp in the river; the stones turn over.

lines.zh: 这一下把我冲出老远。
lines.en: That knocked me far downstream.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比河底的石头硬。
lines.en: Your boot is harder than the river stones.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿游，你却没感觉。
lines.en: I swim by your leg and you never notice.

lines.zh: 撞完我晕了一会儿，才找回方向。
lines.en: After the bump I daze, then find my way.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳞片一起反光。
lines.en: We swim side by side, our scales flashing together.

lines.zh: 你转个弯，我就跟着转。
lines.en: When you turn, I turn with you.

lines.zh: 冷河水里，两只靠得近就暖。
lines.en: In cold water, two close together feel warm.

lines.zh: 这块卵石下面够宽，能容下我们。
lines.en: Under this cobble there is room for us both.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，尾巴扫你的腹。
lines.en: I circle you, my tail brushing your belly.

lines.zh: 我们不分开，游哪都一起。
lines.en: We do not part; wherever we swim, we swim together.

lines.zh: 你的鳞比我亮一点，我承认。
lines.en: Your scales shine a little more; I admit it.

lines.zh: 水流把我们推到一块儿了。
lines.en: The current pushed us together.

lines.zh: 等下有一群鱼过，我们混进去。
lines.en: A school will pass soon; we will join it.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边，我游得稳一些。
lines.en: With you beside me I swim steadier.

lines.zh: 我叼起一片落叶，又吐了。
lines.en: I take a leaf in my mouth and spit it out.

lines.zh: 这粒小石子我含不住。
lines.en: I cannot hold this little pebble.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推它，推到石缝里。
lines.en: I push it with my mouth into a stone crack.

lines.zh: 水里掉下来的东西，我先看再看。
lines.en: Whatever falls in the water, I inspect twice.

lines.zh: 太沉了，我拉一下就松口。
lines.en: Too heavy; I pull once and let go.

lines.zh: 我捡到半只虫，很快吃掉了。
lines.en: I find half a bug and eat it quickly.

lines.zh: 那东西有金属味，我不碰。
lines.en: That thing tastes of metal; I leave it.

lines.zh: 冷水河里，我们成群游。
lines.en: We swim in schools through the cold river.

lines.zh: 你要就还你，我不想惹事。
lines.en: Take it back; I want no trouble.

lines.zh: 我捡的东西都留在石缝里。
lines.en: Everything I find stays in the stone crack.

lines.zh: 水纹一乱，我就知道有东西。
lines.en: The ripples break, and I know something is there.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼在看我，我先看它。
lines.en: That big fish watches me; I watch it first.

lines.zh: 我锁定一只落水的小虫。
lines.en: I lock onto a bug that fell in the water.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼的影子一过，我全身绷紧。
lines.en: A shark's shadow passes and my whole body tightens.

lines.zh: 我不追远的东西，只追近的。
lines.en: I do not chase what is far; only what is near.

lines.zh: 那块石头后面有动静。
lines.en: There is movement behind that stone.

lines.zh: 我盯住水面的钩丝，记住位置。
lines.en: I fix on the fishing line and mark its place.

lines.zh: 目标是吃的，不是打的。
lines.en: My target is food, not a fight.

lines.zh: 我一转身，同伴也跟着转身。
lines.en: I turn, and my school turns with me.

lines.zh: 我先看它有没有牙。
lines.en: First I check whether it has teeth.

lines.zh: 我在等它离石头远一点。
lines.en: I wait for it to move off the stone.

lines.zh: 我绕到下游，从背后靠近。
lines.en: I swing downstream and come from behind.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就停，等它再动。
lines.en: When it moves I stop, and wait for it to move again.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收平，游得没声音。
lines.en: I flatten my fins and swim without a sound.

lines.zh: 这条河太浅，藏不住我。
lines.en: This river is too shallow to hide me.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底，数它的尾鳍摆动。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and count the beats of its tail fin.

lines.zh: 我怕它转身，也怕它不转。
lines.en: I fear it turning, and fear it not turning.

lines.zh: 数到三我就窜，这次真的。
lines.en: On three I dart; this time I mean it.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底过去，泥沙帮我。
lines.en: I skim the bed; the silt hides me.

lines.zh: 它比我想的警觉，我退了。
lines.en: It is warier than I thought; I back off.

lines.zh: 我咬它一口，牙还没长齐。
lines.en: I bite it once; my teeth are not all in.

lines.zh: 我用头撞它，撞得自己发晕。
lines.en: I ram it with my head and daze myself.

lines.zh: 这一下只掉了两片鳞。
lines.en: That only cost me two scales.

lines.zh: 它甩尾，我被拍在石头上。
lines.en: It flicks its tail and slaps me onto stone.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，其实咬不动。
lines.en: I hold on with my teeth, though I cannot bite through.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，半路改了主意。
lines.en: I charge, then change my mind halfway.

lines.zh: 四点血也够我拼一次。
lines.en: Four hearts are enough for one try.

lines.zh: 我撞在它侧腹，弹了回来。
lines.en: I hit its flank and bounce back.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就跑了。
lines.en: It turns, and I am already gone.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我咬得挺快。
lines.en: Small as I am, I bite quickly.

lines.zh: 我在冷河里睁开眼，水刺骨。
lines.en: I open my eyes in cold river water; it stings.

lines.zh: 石缝里挤着两条，我是一条。
lines.en: Two of us crowd the stone crack; I am one.

lines.zh: 河水把我往下游带了一小段。
lines.en: The river carries me a short way downstream.

lines.zh: 我第一次摆尾，就撞上卵石。
lines.en: My first tail beat knocks me into a cobble.

lines.zh: 头顶的水面亮得像块冰。
lines.en: The surface above shines like a sheet of ice.

lines.zh: 我身边那条鱼比我大一点。
lines.en: The fish beside me is a little larger.

lines.zh: 我试着往上游，马上就累了。
lines.en: I try swimming upstream and tire at once.

lines.zh: 这条河的味道，我从没闻过。
lines.en: I have never smelled this river before.

lines.zh: 我藏在石头阴影里，等天亮。
lines.en: I hide in a stone's shadow and wait for daylight.

lines.zh: 水把我放在这儿，我就留下。
lines.en: The water set me here, so here I stay.

lines.zh: 水面在烧，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The surface burns; I dive deeper.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔回河里。
lines.en: I am flung from the water and crash back in.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃黏成一片。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀到石头上。
lines.en: The blast splits the water and throws me onto stone.

lines.zh: 箭从水里穿过，擦掉我一片鳞。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water and shaves a scale.

lines.zh: 一股怪力让我鳞片全竖起来。
lines.en: Strange force makes every scale stand up.

lines.zh: 我饿得去啃石头上的绿毛。
lines.en: Hunger drives me to nibble the green on stones.

lines.zh: 白光落进河里，我全身一僵。
lines.en: White light hits the river and my body locks.

lines.zh: 河底没了，我在空里翻。
lines.en: The riverbed is gone; I tumble in emptiness.
